_note: How much research each run does. Research runs every 15 minutes and starts as many researchers as the queue needs, up to sweep.researchers (the cap on usage); an empty queue starts none. gap_workers searchers run on every other run. The backlog desk only acts when more than backlog.leave_for_sweep stories are waiting. The editor job may move these by at most a quarter a week; the owner can set them to anything. headless true (owner, 2026-11-19): every AI job runs as one scripts/run-job.mjs call in swarm phases (plan, claim leases, work, check, retry, commit, report); a job whose workers cannot read the web here falls back to subagents. sweep.review_workers: every research run also starts up to this many reviewers on the oldest unreviewed events (continuous second review); the hourly review desk catches the rest. flow: research is one continuous loop (run-job.mjs flow): collect, research new stories and review earlier events in parallel, commit, repeat every min_cycle_minutes or as soon as a cycle ends; it lives `minutes` and the research schedules restart it. flow.update_workers: each cycle also starts up to this many updaters on published events with new reporting (scripts/updates.mjs); flow.followup_every_minutes: how often the loop also runs the follow-up desk on developing and claimed events. flow.grid_workers / flow.grid_per_worker: each cycle also runs scripts/grid.mjs collect, then starts up to grid_workers grid researchers (role grid) on the biggest grid outages that need a cause, grid_per_worker incidents each (scripts/grid-desk.mjs plan and apply; 0 turns it off).
